# fix: missing closing brace in openAggregateJavadoc task in javadoc.gradle

## Task

### Problem
`gradle/javadoc.gradle` had a missing closing `}` for the `openAggregateJavadoc` task registration block. This caused `openJavadoc` to be parsed as a nested closure inside it, producing a Groovy parse error at EOF:

> expecting '}', found '' @ line 342, column 1.

### Fix
Added the missing `}` to properly close the `openAggregateJavadoc` closure before the next `tasks.register('openJavadoc')` block.

### Acceptance Criteria
- [x] `gradle/javadoc.gradle` parses without errors
- [x] `openAggregateJavadoc` and `openJavadoc` are sibling tasks, not nested

Parent: Epic #76 (Maintenance, Dependency Upgrades & Housekeeping).
